samas.samasTitleEnglish: Antahkarana Eka (The One Antahkarana / Instrument of Knowing)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: सकळांचे अंतःकारण येक । किंवा येक नव्हे अनेक । ऐसें हे निश्र्चयात्मक । मज निरोपावें ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्वांचें अंतःकरण एकच आहे, का तें वेगवेगळें आहे ? याचे निःसंशय उत्तर मला सांगावें.
owis.englishMeaning: "Is the *antah-karana the same or is it different for everyone? This should be clearly explained to me." *(Faculty or instrument of knowing or the sattwa guna of the indivi- dual)

owis.original: ऐसें श्रोतयानें पुसिलें । अंतःकरण येक किं वेगळालें । याचें उत्तर ऐकिलें । पाहिजे श्रोतीं ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सगळ्यांचे अंतःकरण एकच आहे कां वेगवेगळें आहे असा प्रश्र्ण श्रोत्यानें मला विचारला. त्याचें उत्तर श्रोत्यांनीं ऐकावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Such was the question of the listener, "Is there one antah-karana or are there separate antah-karanas?" In the listener there should be the listening to this reply.

owis.original: समस्तांचें अंतःकर्ण येक । निश्र्चयो जाणावा नेमक । हा प्रत्ययाचा विवेक । तुज निरोपिला ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तुम्ही निःसंशय असें समजा कीं, सर्वांचें अंतःकरण एकच आहे. हा माझा अनुभव आहे आणि तो तुला मी सांगतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The antah-karana is the same for everyone. This can be known when your conviction is steadfast. And then afterwards, that vivek of the nirgun should be understood by you.

owis.original: श्रोता म्हणे वक्तयासी । अंतःकर्ण येक समस्तांसी । तरी मिळेना येकयेकासी । काये निमित्य ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असें ऐकल्यावर श्रोता वक्त्याला विचारतो कीं, सर्वांचें अंतःकरण एकच आहे तर एकाचें अंतःकरण दुसर्‍याच्या अंतःकरणाशी समरस होत नाहीं यांचे कारण काय?
owis.englishMeaning: The listener said to the speaker. "If this antah-karana is the same for everyone then, why does one person not agree with the other?"

owis.original: येक जोवितां अवघे धाले । येक निवता अवघे । येक मरतां अवघे मेले । पाहिजेत कीं ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तसेंच असेल तर एक जेवल्यावर सर्वांचे पोट भरलें पाहिजे. एक शांत झाला तर सगळे शांत झाले पाहिजेत. एक मेल्यावर सगळे मेले पाहिजेत. नाहीं कां ?
owis.englishMeaning: "If this were the case then, when one eats, everyone would be satisfied; if one was content then, everyone would be content; and if one was to die then, everyone would die"

owis.original: येक सुखी येक दुःखी । ऐसें वर्ततें लोकिकीं । येका अंतःकरणाची वोळखी । कैसी जाणावी ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगामधें एक सुखी तर एक दुःखी असें आढळते, असें दिसत असल्यानें सर्वांचे अंतःकरण एक आहे, हे कसें समजावे.
owis.englishMeaning: "But this is not the case in the world. For one is happy and another is miserably. How can it be said that the antah-karana is the same therefore?"

owis.original: जनीं वेगळाली भावना । कोणास कोणीच मिळेना । म्हणौन हें अनुमाना । येत नाहीं ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रत्येक माणसाची भावना वेगळी असते. एका माणसाचे दुसर्‍याशी एकमत आढळत नाहीं. म्हणून सर्वांचें अंतःकरण एक आहे असें मनाला पटत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Everyone in the *world imagines different things and therefore one does not agree with the other. But such conjecture can never bring that thoughtless swarup. *(maharaj- every mind is a world)

owis.original: अंतःकर्ण येक असतें । तरी येकाचें येका कळों येतें । कांहीं चोरितांच न येतें । गौप्य गुह्य ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतःकरण एकच असते तर एकाच्या मनांत काय आहे, हें दुसर्‍यास कळलें असते. मग कांहींच गुप्त राहिले नसते.
owis.englishMeaning: But as there is this one antah-karana then, the one jiva can come to understand that One brahman (within every jiva, there is this knowing faculty and by remaining in this knowing, body consciousness will melt away. Then by remaining in that pure sattwa guna of knowledge, knowledge will also slip away). Then the `thing' cannot be stolen away by a restless mind and that which is hidden (ie. purush) will not remain hidden.

owis.original: याकारणें अनुमानेना । अंतःकर्ण येक हे घडेना । विरोध लागला जना । काये निमित्य ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असा अनुभव येत नाहीं म्हणून हें कांहीं तर्काला बरोबर वाटत नाहीं. सर्वांचे अंतःकरण एक असणें शक्य नाहीं. तसें जर असतें तर लोकांत जो परस्परांत विरोध निर्माण होतो तो झाला नसता. लोकांत विरोध व संघर्ष आढळतात त्याचे कारण काय ?
owis.englishMeaning: Conjecture ceases on account of this `speech'. Still, this antah-karana is not the same as that thoughtless swarup. But tell me, what is stopping the mind from being quiet and simply listening to this `speech'?

owis.original: सर्प डसाया येतो । प्राणी भेऊन पळतो । येक अंतःकर्ण तरी तो । विरोध नसावा ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्प दंश करावयास येतो तर प्राणी घाबरुन दूर पळतो. जर अंतःकरण एक असतें तर असा विरोध परस्परांत आढळला नसता.
owis.englishMeaning: The listener (who did not remain quiet) said, "If a snake comes forward to bite then, the creature fears and runs away. But if the antah-karana was the same then, that creature should not have been disturbed."

owis.original: ऐसी श्रोतयाची आशंका । वक्ता म्हणे चळो नका । सावध होऊन ऐका । निरुपण ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशी श्रोत्याची शंका ऐकून तिचे निरसन करतांना वक्त्ता म्हणाला, श्रोत्यांनी गोंधळून जाऊं नये. याचे उत्तर लक्षपूर्वक ऐकावे.
owis.englishMeaning: Such was the doubt of the listener and so the Master says, be still in your mind and don't let it move. Be very alert and listen to this `I am'.

owis.original: अंतःकर्ण म्हणिजे जाणीव । जाणीव जाणता स्वभाव । देहरक्षणाचा उपाव । जाणती कळा ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतःकरण म्हणजे जाणीव. जाणीव म्हणजे जाणण्याची स्वाभाविक शक्ति. या जाणण्याच्या शक्तीनेंच प्राण्याला देहरक्षणाचा उपाय सुचतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The antah-karana means knowing. Then there is a knower naturally knowing. And by means of this knowing your body is protected. (The antah-karana means this knowing within the body. But this gets further divided into five separate divisions; see 17.8. There is the antah-karana which knows, and mind which knows something, and buddhi to decide what it is, and chitta to think about it over and over and finally the ego to take possession of it)

owis.original: सर्प जाणोन डंखूं आला । प्राणी जाणोन पळाला । दोहींकडे जाणीवेला । बरें पाहा ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एकीकडे जाणिवेच्या प्रेरणेंने सर्प दंश करायला येतो व त्याच जाणिवेच्या प्रेरणेनें प्राणी सर्पापासून दूर पळतो. म्हणजे सर्प व प्राणी या दोघांमध्यें जाणिवच कार्य करते.
owis.englishMeaning: Because the snake knows, it moved forward to bite and because the creature knows, it ran away. Both the creatures know; understand this clearly.

owis.original: दोहींकडे जाणीवेसी पाहिलें । तरी अंतःकर्ण येकचि जालें । विचारितां प्रत्यया आलें । जाणीवरुपें ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दोघांमध्यें जाणीव आहे. तिची प्रेरणा एकच आहे. म्हणून दोघांचें अंतःकरण एकरुप असलेंच पाहिजे. अशा रीतीनें विचार करतां जाणिवेच्या दृष्टीनें सर्व प्राण्यांचें अंतःकरण समान असतें हा प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव येतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When it is seen that this knowing is with both then, you can understand that this antah-karana is the same. And it is due to this knowing form that, that thoughtless nirgun comes (by remaining in knowing, one becomes knowledge and then this gets submerged in thoughtlessness).

owis.original: जाणीवरुपें अंतःकर्ण । सकळांचे येक हें प्रमाण । जीवमात्रास जाणपण । येकचि असे ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणीवरुपानें सर्व जीवांचें अंतःकरण एकच असतें. ही गोष्ट सिद्ध झाली. जेवढें जीवप्राणी आहेत त्यांची जाणण्याची कला त्यांच्या अंतर्यामी एकच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: There is this knowing that is the antah-karana; there is that One Knower of this `all' and there is that thoughtless swarup (the knowing antah-karana is said to be within the body. This is the sattwa guna and when you remain with this then, that triad of Knower, knowing and knower is formed. And all this takes place upon that Reality). Thus the knowingness of the jiva is that thoughtless swarup. (We say, `We know' but, it is the sattwa guna knowing. And this knowing of the jiva takes place within knowledge (pure sattwa guna). And this knowledge has appeared upon that thoughtless swarup).

owis.original: येके दृष्टीचें देखणें । येके जिव्हेचें चाखणें । ऐकणें स्पर्शणें वास घेणें । सर्वत्रास एक ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उदा. डोळ्यांनी पाहणें, जिभेनें चाखणें, कानानें ऐकणें, अंगानें स्पर्श करणें, नाकानें वास घेणें या इंद्रियांच्या अनुभवामध्यें सर्वांना प्रचिती येते. कारण अनुभव घेणारी जाणीव सर्वांच्या ठिकाणीं सारखीच असते.
owis.englishMeaning: Everyone sees with the eyes; everyone tastes with the tongue. Hearing, touching and smelling is the same for everyone.

owis.original: पशु पक्षी किडा मुंगी । जीवमात्र निर्माण जगीं । जाणीवकळा सर्वांलागीं । येकचि आहे ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पशु, पक्षी, किडे, मुंग्या असें अनंत प्रकारचे प्राणी जगांत निर्माण होतात. पण त्यांच्यांत इतर बाबतींत विविधता असली तरी सर्वांच्या ठिकाणीं जाणण्याची कला मात्र एकच असते.
owis.englishMeaning: The animals, birds, insects, every jiva born in this world, have this same unique `art' of knowing that is within this `all' body (pure sattwa guna of prakruti/purush). And still there is One only.

owis.original: सर्वांस जळ तें सीतळ । सर्वांस अग्नि तेजाळ । सर्वांस अंतःकर्ण केवळ । जाणती कळा ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पाणी सर्वांना गारच लागतें. अग्नि सर्वांना उष्णच लागतो. याचा अर्थ असा कीं अंतःकरण म्हणजे जाणण्याची कला एकच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: It is this `all' that knows the coolness of water and it is this `all' that knows the heat of a fire. There is that pure knowledge; there is this `all' and upon that there is this antah-karana, the `art' of the knower. (Pure knowledge has nothing to do with all this. Now, when in your mind there is the knowing of water, cold, fire, heat etc. and you say "I am knowing", still understand this knowing is actually taking place in the triad of Knower, knowing and known. This knowledge does not say, "Water, cold, hot" etc., it does not discriminate between them; it is satisfied to just know whatever comes its way).

owis.original: आवडे नावडे ऐसें जालें । तरी हें देहस्वभावावरी गेलें । परंतु हें कळों आलें । अंतःकर्णयोगें ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्याला एखादी वस्तु आवडते, एखाद्याला ती आवडत नाहीं. ही आवड किंवा नावड माणसाच्या देहस्वभावावर अवलंबून आहे. पण वस्तूची आवड किंवा नावड ही अंतःकरणाच्या योगानेंच कळते.
owis.englishMeaning: But when likes and dislikes of body consciousness appear then, this `all' body and thoughtlessness are destroyed. But this thoughtlessness can be understood by Its union with this antah-karana (ie. first be the sattwa guna. Then become knowledge and then, let this melt away; see first night abhanga- tuka says, day and night make this sattwa guna).

owis.original: सर्वांचें अंतःकर्ण येक । ऐसा निश्र्चयो निश्र्चयात्मक । जाणती याचें कौतुक । चहुंकडे ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्व प्रान्यांचे अंतःकरण एकच एकआहे ही गोष्ट निःसंशय व निश्र्चयात्मक आहे. नवल वाटण्यासारखी याची लीला जगांत चहूकडे पाहातां येते.
owis.englishMeaning: Have the firm conviction that this antah-karana of this `all' is that One thoughtless swarup. Then the knower (ie. jiva) will be this wonder of knowing in every place (`I am everywhere').

owis.original: इतुकेन फिटली आशंका । आतां अनुमान करुं नका । जाणणें तितुकें येका । अंतःकर्णाचें ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: इतकें सांगितल्यानें श्रोत्यांची शंका फिटली. श्रोत्यांनी आतां उगीच तर्क काढूं नयेत. जेथें जेथें जाणणें आढळतें, तें एका अंतःकरणाचे असते हें ओळखावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this knowing every doubt will be cast away. Now, do not make any conjecture. Then by this knowing of this antah-karana there will be that One.

owis.original: जाणोन जीव चारा घेती । जाणोन भिती लपती । जाणोनियां पळोन जाती । प्राणीमात्र ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या जाणिवेच्या प्रेरणेनें प्राणी चारा खातात, तिच्या प्रेरणेनें प्राणी भितात आणि लपतात. तिच्याच प्रेरणेनें प्राणी पळून जातात.
owis.englishMeaning: While knowing, the jiva takes food. While knowing, the jiva fears and hides and while knowing, every creature runs away.

owis.original: किडामुंगीपासून ब्रह्मादिक । समस्तांस अंतःकर्ण येक । ये गोष्टीचें कौतुक । प्रत्यें जाणावें ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अगदी किडामुंगीपासून तें ब्रह्मादिकांपर्यंत सर्वांचें अंतःकरण एकच असते. आणि या गोष्टीचे प्रमाण आपण प्रत्यक्ष अनुभवावें.
owis.englishMeaning: In the smallest ant to lord brahma etc., there is that One and this knowledge that has become an antah-karana. The thoughtless Self should be directly experienced through this knowing, that has come from this wonder of knowledge (so just know, then be knowledge, then be thoughtless). (siddharameshwar maharaj- you think that you don't have this knowledge. But it is already with you)

owis.original: थोर लहान तरी अग्नी । थोडें बहु तरी पाणी । न्यून पूर्ण तरी प्राणी । अंतःकर्णे जाणती ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अग्नि लहान असों कीं मोठा असो अग्नि तो अग्निच. पाणी थोंडे असो कीं पुष्कळ तेम पाणीच असतें. त्याचप्रमाणें जाणीव पूर्ण असो कीं कमी असो सर्व प्राणी अंतःकरणानेंच जाणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The fire may be the great or it may be small but still it is fire. The water may be a drop or it may be vast ocean but still it is water. The creature may know very little or it may know everything but still it knows by means of this antah-karana.

owis.original: कोठें उणें कोठें अधीक । परंतु जिनसमासला येक । जंगम प्राणी कोणीयेक । जाटिल्याविण नाहीं ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणीव कांहीं प्राण्यांत कमी तर कांहीं प्राण्यांत पुष्कळ आढळते. परंतु सगळीकडे तिचे मूळस्वरुप एकच असते. कोणीही हालचाल करणारा  जिवंत प्राणी जाणिवेवांचून असूच शकत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: In some places it is less and in some places it is more, but this antah-karana knows the object's form. No living creature is without this knowing.

owis.original: जाणीव म्हणिजे अंतःकर्ण । अंतःकर्ण विष्णूचा अंश जाण । विष्णू करितो पाळण । येणें प्रकारें ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणीव म्हणजे अंतःकरण व अंतःकरण विष्णुचा अंश आहे. अशा रीतीनें विष्णु जगाचें पालन करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Knowing means the antah-karana and this antah-karana is a part of vishnu. And by this vishnu (sattwa guna), that One is the protector of every creature.

owis.original: नेणतां प्राणी संव्हारतो । नेणीव तमोगुण बोलिजेतो । तमोगुणें रुद्र संव्हारितो । येणें प्रकारें ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याच्या ठिकाणीं जाणीव नसतें किंवा जाणीव नाश पावते तो प्राणी नाश पावतो. नेणीव हें तमोगुणाचें लक्षण आहे. अशा रीतीनें तमोगुणानें रुद्र संहार करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is no knowing then, the creature is destroyed (where are you when you sleep? maharaj- sleep is a small death). This not knowing should be called tamo guna and this is also called rudra the destroyer.

owis.original: कांहीं जाणीव कांहीं नेणीव । हा रजोगुणाचा स्वभाव । जाणतां नेणतां जीव । जन्मास येती ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: थोडी जाणीव व थोडी नेणीव यांचें मिश्रण असणें हें रजोगुणाचें लक्षण आहे. असें जाणीव नेणीव मिश्रित असणारे जीव पुन्हा जन्म घेतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When something is known and something is not known then, this should be called rago guna. It is this mixture of knowing and non-knowing that brings the birth of the jiva.

owis.original: जाणीवेनें होतें सुख । नेणीवेनें होतें दुःख । सुखदुःख अवश्यक । उत्पत्तिगुणें ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणिवेंनें जीवास सुख होतें. नेणीवेनें जीवास दुःख होतें. म्हणून जन्मास आल्यावर जीवाला सुख आणि दुःख दोन्हीआवश्यकपणें भोगावीं लागतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to knowing there is happiness ("Ah! I know") and due to not knowing there is suffering. Happiness and suffering are certain when there are these three gunas take a birth.

owis.original: जाणण्यानेणण्याची बुद्धि । तोचि देही जाणावा विधी । स्थूळ देहीं ब्रह्मा त्रिशुद्धि । उत्पत्तिकर्ता ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: रजोगुणांच्या पोटीं असणारी जाणीवनेणीव मिश्रण असणारी जी बुद्धि तोच देहामधील ब्रह्मदेवाचा अंश ओळखावा. निर्माण करणारा ब्रह्मा अशा रीतीनें खरोखर स्थूल देहांत आढळतो.
owis.englishMeaning: This not-knowing and knowing is the buddhi/intellect. Then that atma is in the body and it should be known as lord brahma. In the gross body, brahma is truly the creator.1

owis.original: ऐसा उत्पत्ति स्थिति संहार । प्रसंगें बोलिला विचार । परंतु याचा निर्धार । प्रत्यें पाहावा ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विषय निघाला म्हणून या प्रसंगानें उत्तप्ती, स्थिति व संहार यांचें विवेचन केलें. परंतु प्रत्यक्ष प्रचीति पाहून याबद्दल निश्र्चित मत बनवावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Like this is the creation (ie. brahma), maintenance (ie. vishnu) and destruction (ie. rudra) of this world. And these three gunas are on account of this connection with the `I am' and that thoughtless swarup. But the thoughtlessness of this `I am' has to be understood by direct experience (ie. while witnessing there is indirect experience of that thoughtless nirgun; maharaj- you know something, that is vishnu; you give it a name, that is brahma; you close your eyes and that is mahesh/rudra) .

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: स्वामीनें विचार दाखविला । येथें विष्णूचा अभाव दिसोन आला । ब्रह्मा विष्णु महेशाला । उरी नाहीं ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मागल्या समासांत स्वामींनी एक विचार मांडला. तो असा कीं, ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, महेश या देवतां शरीरांत आहेत. परंतु या देवतांना कोठें स्थानच नाहीं. त्या शरीरांत आहेत असा अनुभव येत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When swami reveals that thoughtless Self then, vishnu is proved to be non-existence (even knowing is illusion). Then neither brahma, vishnu nor mahesh remain.

owis.original: उत्पत्ति स्थिति संहार । ब्रह्मा विष्णु महेश्र्वर । याचा पाहातां विचार । प्रत्ययो नाहीं ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, महेश उत्पत्ति, स्थिति, संव्हार घडवितात काय ? याचा विचारानें शोध घेतला तर तसा अनुभव येत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: If this world is created, maintained and destroyed then, there is brahma, vishnu and mahesh. And when there is this mix of the gunas then, this `I am' and that thoughtless nirgun cannot be understood.

owis.original: ब्रह्मा उत्पत्तिकर्ता चौमुखांचा । येथें प्रत्ययो नाहीं त्याचा । पाळणकर्ता विष्णु चौभुजांचा । तो हि ऐकोन जाणों ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उत्पत्ति करणारा ब्रह्मदेव चार तोंडांचा आहे असें सांगतात. पण त्याचा कधीं अनुभव येत नाहीं. पालन करणारा विष्णु चार हातांचा आहे असें म्हणतात. परंतु त्याला कधीं कोणी पाहिला नाहीं. तो नुसता ऐकून माहीत आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: brahma, the creator has four faces representing the four forms of birth. When he is here creating names and forms then, thoughtlessness cannot be. vishnu with his four arms protects every jiva and when he is knowing then, forget everything and just listen to this `I am'.

owis.original: महेश संव्हार करितो । हाहि प्रत्ययो कैसा येतो । लिंगमहिमा पुराणीं तो । विपरीत बोलिला ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: महेश संहार करतो असें म्हणतात. पण त्याचा अनुभव कसा तें माहीत नाहीं. पुराणांमध्यें शंकराच्या लिंगाचा महिमा वेगळाच सांगितला आहे. तो विपरीत भासतो.
owis.englishMeaning: mahesh is the destroyer (ie. not knowing) but how can he bring that thoughtless un- derstanding? And when He is shiva (ie. forget everything and He is there) then, there is this false `I am' that resides within that ancient and eternal paramatma.

owis.original: मूळमायेस कोणें केलें । हें तो पाहिजे कळलें । तिही देवांचे रुप जालें । ऐलिकडे ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या तिन्ही देवांचे प्रगटपणें रुप धारण करणें मायेच्या अलीकडचें आहे. ती मूळमाया कोणी केली हें कळलें पाहिजे.
owis.englishMeaning: But how can there really be a creator of this non-existence mula maya? Therefore thoughtlessness should be understood. These three gods/gunas have appeared on this side of mula maya.

owis.original: मूळमाया लोकजननी । तयेपासून गुणक्षोभिणी । गुणक्षोभिणीपासून त्रिगुणी । जन्म देवा ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मूळमाया ही खरी विश्वजननी आहे. तिच्यापासून गुणक्षोभिणी जन्मली. गुणक्षोभिणीपासून सत्व, रज, तम हे तीन गुण जन्मले. त्या तीन गुणांपासून त्रिदेव जन्मले आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: mula maya is the mother of the world. From her has come this `agitation of the gunas'. From the `agitation of the gunas' these three gods have been born.

owis.original: ऐसें बोलती शास्त्रकारक । आणि प्रवृत्तीचेहि लोक । प्रत्यये पुसतां कित्येक । अकांत करिती ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शास्त्र रचणारे शास्त्रकर्ते व शास्त्र प्रमाण मानणारे सामान्य लोक देवांच्या उत्पत्तीबद्दल असें सांगतात. हे देव आहेत याविषयीं कांहीं प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव आहे काय ? असें विचारलें कीं त्यांपैकीं बरेच लोक आकांडतांडव करतात.
owis.englishMeaning: This mula maya is the creator of the shasthras and the creator of this worldly existence also. For when that nirgun understanding gets wiped out then, that One within is made to shout out loud (first it shouts out `I am' and then he shouts out "I am so and so, I know better than you" etc. etc).

owis.original: म्हणोन त्यास पुसावेना । त्यांचेन प्रत्ययो आणवेना । प्रत्ययेंविण प्रेत्न नाना । ठकाठकी ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून त्यांना विचारण्याची सोय नाहीं. त्या देवांच्या अस्तित्वाचा प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव ते लोक आणून देऊं शकत नाहीत. ज्याचा प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव येत नाहीं त्यासाठीं नाना प्रयत्न करणें म्हणजे नुसती फसवाफसवी होते.
owis.englishMeaning: But when thoughtlessness is not wiped out, then where are these gunas? And if this understanding is not then, there is only the deception and dishonesty of `many' efforts.

owis.original: प्रचितीवीण वैद्य म्हणवी । उगीच करी उठाठेवी । तया मूर्खाला गोवी । प्राणीमात्र ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा माणूस रोग व त्यांचे उपचार यांचें ज्ञान नसतांना उगाच आपल्याला वैद्य म्हणवूं लागला तर त्याचा व्यवसाय म्हणजे नस्ती उठाठेव होते. अशा मूर्खाला सर्व लोक अडचणींत टाकतात.
owis.englishMeaning: If the doctor who does not know this `experience' is called for, then his patient will suffer unnecessarily (he can give `many' remedies and sadhanas but he can only offer a continued life in the prana). For he is also a fool entangled in the prana.

owis.original: तैसाच हाहि विचार । प्रत्यये करावा निर्धार । प्रत्ययें नस्तां अंधकार । गुरुशिष्यांसी ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या देवांच्या बाबतींत असाच प्रकार होतो. येथें प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव घेऊन मग आपलें निश्र्चित मत बनवावें. प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव नसेल तर गुरु व शिष्य दोघेहि अज्ञानाच्या अंधारामध्यें भ्रमत राहातात.
owis.englishMeaning: This `experience' therefore should be gained and so too, the conviction of that thought- less nirgun. Where there is not that nirgun understanding, then the guru and shishya are both stumbling around in darkness.

owis.original: बरें लोकांस काये म्हणावें । लोक म्हणती तेंचि बरवें । परंतु स्वामीनें सांगावें । विशद करुनी ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बरें लोकांना तरी नांवें कां ठेवावीत? लोक म्हणतील तेंच बरोबर आहे असें म्हणावें लागतें. म्हणून स्वामीनीं हा विषय स्पष्ट करुन सांगावा.
owis.englishMeaning: 10.2. These Bodies are Doubt Why should the wise *say anything about this world of darkness? (maharaj- don't care for anything) This world calls itself wise but only the swami can tell you what wisdom truly is. *(Be quiet in your mind)

owis.original: म्हणों देवीं माया केली । तरी देवांचीं रुपें मायेंत आलीं । जरी म्हणो मायेनें माया केली । तरी दुसरी नाहीं ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवांनीं माय केली असें म्हणावें तर देवचमुळीं मायेनें निर्माण केले आहेत. देवांचीं रुपें मायामय आहेत. मायेनें माया निर्माण केली म्हणावें तर मूळमाया एकच आहे, दोन नाहींत.
owis.englishMeaning: If a guru says, "maya has been created in God" then, these forms in maya are God. Or if he says, "maya has been made by maya", then there is nothing other than maya.

owis.original: जरी म्हणों भूतीं केली । तरी ते भूतांचीच वळली । म्हणावें जरी परब्रह्में केली । तरी ब्रह्मीं कर्तुत्व नाहीं ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पंचभूतांनी माया केली म्हणावें तर मूळमायेमध्यें पंचभूतें भरुन आहेत. म्हणून तें शक्य नाहीं. परब्रह्मानें माया निर्माण केलीं म्हणावें तर परब्रह्मामध्यें कर्तेपण नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: If he says, "That Reality within the five great elements has made everything" then, even that Reality is made of the great elements. And if he says, "It was made by parabrahman then, there would be no creative capacity of maya."

owis.original: आणी माया खरी असावी । तरी ब्रह्मीं कर्तुत्वाची गोवी । माया मिथ्या ऐसी जाणावी । तरी कर्तुत्व कैंचें ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शिवाय माया जर खरी असती तर परब्रह्माकडे कर्तेपण देण्याचा प्रश्र्ण होता. माया जर खरीच नाहीं तर तिला निर्माण करण्याच्या कर्तृत्वाचा प्रश्र्णच येत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: And if he says, "maya is true" then, in brahman there comes this entanglement of doing. But if maya is known to be false, then how can He do anything?

owis.original: आतां हें अवघेंचि उगवें । आणी मनास प्रत्यये फावे । ऐसें केलें पाहिजे देवें । कृपाळूपणें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शेवटीं श्रोता म्हणतो कीं, हें सारें प्रश्र्ण सुटून मनाला अनुभव येईल असें विवेचन सद्गुरुनीं कृपाळू होऊन करावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Now the `many' things should shine (become knowledge) and that mind should reach that nirgun understanding. Such should be made, by the grace of God (grace means do what the Master says and see for yourself).

owis.original: वेद मातृकावीण नाहीं । मातृका देहावीण नाहीं । देह निर्माण होत नाहीं । देहावेगळा ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वेद शब्दमय आहेत. शब्द अक्षरापासून बनतात. सर्व अक्षरांचें मूळ ओंकाराच्या साडेतीन मात्रांमध्यें आहे. म्हणून वेद हें मात्रामय आहेत. ओंकार देहाशिवाय साकार होत नाहीं. आणि देहावाचून देह निर्माण होत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Without this `word' of mula maya there are no vedas. And without this `all' body there is no `word' (ie. to know and to be). And the other bodies of the causal, subtle, gross cannot be created without this `all' body.

owis.original: तया देहामधें नरदेहो । त्या नरदेहांत ब्राह्मणदेहो । तया ब्राह्मणदेहास पाहो । अधिकार वेदीं ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहांमध्यें नरदेह उत्तम मानतात. नरदेहामध्यें ब्राह्मणदेह श्रेष्ठ मानतात. ब्राह्मणदेहाला वेदांचा अधिकार आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Within this `all' body there is the human body and in that human body there is that body (`all') of the brahmin (Knower of brahman). This brahmin uses this `all' but He does not touch it and He is the only one who understands the inner meaning of the vedas (He uses knowledge to be in the world. But this knowledge is no different from Himself ie. no-otherness).

owis.original: असो वेद कोठून जाले । देह कासयाचे केले । देव कैसे प्रगटले । कोण्या प्रकारें ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असो. येथें प्रश्न येतों कीं वेद कोठून निर्माण झाले ? देह कशाचे बनवले ? आणि देव कोणत्या रीतीनें दृश्य आकाराला आलें ?
owis.englishMeaning: He knows from where the vedas have come. He knows how the bodies are made. He knows how the gods (ie. gunas) have appeared and what their nature is.

owis.original: ऐसा बळावला अनुमान । केलें पाहिजे समाधान । वक्ता म्हणे सावधान । होईं आतां ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रोत्यांचा तर्कअसा धावूं लागला. त्यांचे समाधान करणें जरुर आहे. म्हणून वक्ता म्हणाला कीं, अगदीं लक्षपूर्वक उत्तर ऐकावें.
owis.englishMeaning: He gives complete contentment to those drowning in conjecture. The speaker/Master says, forget everything and now listen very carefully to this `I am'.

owis.original: प्रत्यये पाहातां सांकडी । अवघी होते विघडाविघडी । अनुमानितां घडीनें घडी । काळ जातो ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव बघितला तर खरोखर अडचण निर्माण होते. कारण शास्त्रें जें प्रतिपादन करतात त्याच्याशी अनुभवाचा विरोध होतो. आणि त्यावर तर्क करीत राहिलें तर निकाल लागत नाहींच उलट क्षणाक्षणाने काळ मात्र फुकट जातो.
owis.englishMeaning: For if that nirgun understanding is caught in the confinement of a human body then, it gets completely spoiled and then every moment is passed away in conjecture and opinions.

owis.original: लोकधाटी शास्त्रनिर्णये । येथें बहुधा निश्र्चये । म्हणोनियां येक प्रत्यये । येणार नाहीं ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लोकांचीं मतें काय व शास्त्राचे निर्णय काय नाना प्रकारचे असतात. म्हणून त्यांच्यामध्यें एकनिश्र्चित असा सिद्धान्त आढळत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: In the distress and clamour of this world there are the laws set down by the scriptures. But they can only bring the many different convictions of a worldly life and therefore there cannot be that one conviction of thoughtlessness.

owis.original: आतां शास्त्राची भीड धरावी । तरी सुटेना हे गथागोवी । गथागोवी हे उगवावी । तरी शास्त्रभेद दिसे ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्यामुळें असें होतें कीं, शास्त्राचे निर्णय सांभाळण्याचा प्रयत्न केला तर हा घोटाळा उलगडत नाहीं. आणि हा घोटाळा उलगडण्याचा प्रयत्न केला तर शास्त्रांच्या निर्णयामध्यें एकमत आढळत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: If now respect for the scriptures/shasthras is kept, then that thoughtless swarup cannot be cut from this entanglement. And if that thoughtless unravels this entanglement then, it will disagree with the scriptures (shasthras can teach up to this `I am experience' ie. 10.2. These Bodies are Doubt neti, neti but they have no capacity to go beyond this knowledge).

owis.original: शास्त्र रक्षून प्रत्यये आणिला । पूर्वक्ष त्यागून सिद्धांत पाहिला । शाहाणा मूर्ख समजाविला । येका वचनें ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपलें उत्तर असें पाहिजे कीं, एकीकडे शास्त्राच्या प्रामाण्याला धक्का लागूं नये आणि दुसरीकडे प्रत्यक्ष अनुभवाशीं त्याचा विरोध येऊं नये. आधीं पूर्वपक्ष मांडावा. त्यांतील दोष दाखवून तो बाजूस सारावा, आणि मग आपला सिद्धान्त प्रतिपादन करावा. एकच उत्तर द्यावें पण त्यानें शहाणा व अडाणी दोघांचे समाधान व्हावें.
owis.englishMeaning: The scriptures are to be protected therefore and then that understanding of nirgun is to be brought. When this original hypothesis `I am' is abandoned then, that Truth/si- ddhant (I do not exist) is understood. The foolish therefore should understand the wisdom of this divine `speech' (neti, neti).

owis.original: शास्त्रींच पूर्वपक्ष बोलिला । पूर्वपक्ष म्हणावें लटक्याला । विचार पाहातं आम्हांला । शब्द नाहीं ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शास्त्रामध्यें पूर्वापार सांगण्याची रीत आहे. पूर्वपक्ष अपुरा असतो. खरा नसतो. म्हणून येथें पूर्वपक्ष मांडला आणि त्याचे विवेचन केलें तर आम्हांला त्यांत दोष देता येणार नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Within the scriptures there is this original hypothesis and this is `I am'. Still, you should understand that this hypothesis is false and when thoughtlessness is understood then, this `word' should not be uttered.

owis.original: तथापि बोलों कांहीयेक । शास्त्र रक्षून कौतुक । श्रोतीं सादर विवेक । केला पाहिजे ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तथापि शास्त्रांचे प्रामाण्य रक्षण करुन या विषयाचें कौतुकानें थोडे विवेचन करतो. श्रोत्यांनी आदरानें त्याचा विचार करावा.
owis.englishMeaning: Still as long as there is this `speech' then, the scriptures are protected and this will bring the wonder of `I am everywhere'. Therefore in the listener there should be respect for this vivek (not this, not that). Note: It is said there are three kinds of experience. The experience gained from the shrasthras; the experience gained from the guru and finally one's own direct experience. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Deha Aashanka Shodhan (Investigation of the Doubts about the Body)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: उपाधीवीण जे आकाश । तेंचि ब्रह्म निराभास । तें निराभासीं मूळमायेस । जन्म जाला ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आकाशाला मर्यादा असते. ते वेगळेपणानें भासतें. मर्यादा व वेगळेपाणाचा भास बाजूस टाकला तर तेंच आकाश ब्रह्म बनतें. अशा अमर्याद व भासहीन ब्रह्मामध्यें मूळ माया जन्मली.
owis.englishMeaning: When space is without the limiting concept of mula maya, then this is that impercep- tible brahman. And in that imperceptible Self, mula maya has taken a birth.

owis.original: तें मूळमायेचें लक्षण । वायोस्वरुपचि जाण । पंचभूतें आणि त्रिगुण । वायोअआंगीं ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वायुस्वरुप असणें हें मूळमायेचें लक्षण होय. पांच भूतें व तीन गुण वायुमध्यें अंतर्भूत असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When that Reality has this attention of mula maya then, know that there is this wind/vayu along with that swarup. The five great elements and the three gunas are contained within this `all' body of the wind (ie. there was the One and it became two. This is prakruti and purush or the wind and space. And within this wind there is the fire, water and earth elements)

owis.original: आकाशापासून वायो जाला । तो वायोदेव बोलिला । वायोपासून अग्नी जाला । तो अग्निदेव ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आकाशापासून वायु निर्माण झाला. त्यास वायुदेव म्हणतात. वायूपासून अग्नि झाला. त्यास अग्निदेव म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: From the *space, this wind has appeared. This is the `I am' and in this wind, God is present (you say, nothing is there, but who is the one who knows this nothing?). From the wind, the fire element appears and in this fire, God is present. *(maharaj- when you awake, space is there. When space it there then knowledge must be there)

owis.original: अग्नीपासून जालें आप । तें नारायेणाचें स्वरुप । आपापासून पृथ्वीचें रुप । तें बीजाकारें ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अग्नीपासून आप निर्माण झालें. तें नारायणाचे स्वरुप आहे. आपापासून पृथ्वी निर्माण झालीं. तिचें रुप बीजाकार आहे. बीजामध्यें ज्याप्रमाणें संपूर्ण वृक्ष सामावलेला असतो, त्याचप्रमाणें पृथ्वीमध्यें शक्ति गुप्तपणें असतें.
owis.englishMeaning: From the fire, the water element appears (`soft' appearance of individual forms). Still there is that swarup of narayan present. From the water there appears the gross external earth form and that is the seed of the `many' shapes and forms. (This is the process of objectification upon that swarup. Space and wind appear simultaneously and there is the feeling `I am' or `I know'. This is knowledge. No effort is required to simply know and be. When one gives one's attention to an outside or makes a little effort to see then, one has become a little more objective. When one gives one's attention to a particular object then, an object appears. When one gives it a name then, it takes on a gross form and is considered true. Then that swarup is completely drowned, as if It were not there).

owis.original: ते पृथ्वीचे पोटी पाषाण । बहु देवांचे लक्षण । नाना प्रचित प्रमाण । पाषाणदेवीं ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पृथ्वीच्या पोटांत पुष्कळ पाषाण आहेत. त्यपैकीं कांहीं पाषाणांमध्यें देबाचे रुप मानतात. अशा पाषाणांमध्यें देव वास्तव करतात याची प्रचीती येते. पाषाणांमध्यें देव असण्याचें हेंच प्रमाण समजावें.
owis.englishMeaning: In the womb of this earth element there is this stone called the gross body and this attention brings the `many' gods. Within this `stone god' (ie. body consciousness) there are the `many' concepts and forms, there is this `experience' and there is that thou- ghtless Self when all imagining ceases (since these objects are only imagined then, that thoughtless swarup had never left).

owis.original: नाना वृक्ष मृत्तिका । प्रचित रोकडी विश्र्वलोकां । समस्त देवांचा थारा येका । वायोमध्यें ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक वृक्षांमध्यें आणि मातीच्या मूर्तिंमध्यें देव आहे असा रोकडा अनुभव या विश्र्वांतील पुष्कळ लोकांना येतो. या सर्व देवांना एका वायूचा आश्रय असतो. हे सर्व देव शक्तीचीं विविध रुपें आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: Within the womb of this earth, there are `many' trees of wood and `many' clays (ie. the many different hard, gross bodies); there is this ever present `experience' or prakruti and there is that One within this wind, who is the support of all these gods like brahma (He is the purush who is within His prakruti).

owis.original: देव यक्षिणी कात्यायेणी । चामुंडा जखिणी मानविणी । नाना शक्ति नाना स्थानीं । देशपरत्वें ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देव, यक्षिणी, कात्यायणी, चामुंडा, जाखिणी, मानविंणी वगैरे अनेक प्रकारच्या शक्ति निरनिराळ्या देशांमध्यें वेगवेगळ्या ठिकाणीं आढळतात.
owis.englishMeaning: There is that God and on account of this *space there comes these many goddesses like yakshini, katyayani, chamunda, jakhini and manavani. Then there are the many enchanting attractions and there are killings and beatings, and show and pretense, and this worn and decrepit body, and this disrespectful and dishonorable mind. Then there are the `many' forms of power and the `many' places. *(From that purush and prakruti ie. nothing; everything comes)

owis.original: पुरुषनामें कि्येक । देव असती अनेक । भूतें देवतें नपुषक । नामें बोलिजेती ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पुल्लिंगी नावें असणारें कितीतरी देव आहेत. त्याचप्रमाणें दैवतें, भूतें अशी नपुसंक नामें असणारें देव आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: That One within these `many' forms is the male purush and He is with His female prakruti and therefore these `many' forms are, in truth, that One God. The elements and the deities (ie. gunas) are neither that male nor this female and have no power, for they are *imagined. Therefore the imagined should be forgotten and this `I am' should be `spoken'. *(When these elements and gunas start to manifest then there is objectification or imagination and finally the numerous forms. But as soon as you stop imagining, where is the power of these objects?)

owis.original: देव देवता देवतें भूतें । पृथ्वीमध्यें असंख्यातें । परंतु या समस्तांतें । वायोस्वरुप बोलिजे ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगामध्यें देव, देवता, दैवतें आणी भूतें खरोखर असंख्य आहेत. परंतु ही सर्व वायुस्वरुप आहेत. हीं सगळीं शक्तीचीं रुपें आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: Within this earth element, the seed of many shapes, and on account of that immea- surable parabrahman, there is that God, His Goddess, these deities and the elements (purush, prakruti, gunas and elements). Therefore all these objects should be known as this wind and that swarup (therefore all these concepts should be dropped).

owis.original: वायोस्वरुप सदा असणें । प्रसंगें नाना देह धरणें । गुप्त प्रगट होणें जाणें । समस्तांसी ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या सर्व देवता नेहमीं वायुरुपानें राहतात. प्रसंगीं त्या निरनिराळे देह धारण करतात. गुप्त असलेले प्रगट व्हायचे व प्रगट असलेले गुप्त व्हायचे अशारीतीनें या सगळ्या देवता वास करतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Always there is this wind/prakruti and swarup/purush. And it is due to this `I am' connection that, there is the holding of these `many' bodies. Then that hidden purush and this manifest prakruti come and go as these `many' forms.

owis.original: वायोस्वरुपें विचरती । वायोमध्यें जगज्ज्योती । जाणतीकळा वासना वृत्ति । नाना भेदें ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या देव देवता वायुरुपानें सगळीकडे संचार करतात. वायूमध्यें जगत् ज्योती आहे. ती जाणीवरुप आहे. ही जी जाणीव आहे तिच्यामध्यें वासनेमुळें नाना प्रकारचे भेद निर्माण होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Everything moves due to this wind and swarup. And within this wind there is the `light of the world' (existence, `I am') and this `art' of knowing (knowledge). They are also called the vasana and the vritti. And within this wind there are also these `many' dif- ferences (when objectification takes place you say, "I am so and so and I know this and that").

owis.original: आकाशापासून वायो जाला । तो दों प्रकारें विभागला । सावधपणें विचार केला । पाहिजे श्रोतीं ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आकाशापासून वायु निर्माण झाला तेव्हां त्याचे दोन विभाग झाले. श्रोत्यांनी त्याचा लक्षपूर्वक विचार केला पाहिजे.
owis.englishMeaning: From the space this wind appeared and that One was divided into these two forms. Therefore by being very alert, thoughtlessness should be created in the listener.

owis.original: येक वारा सकळ जाणती । येक वायो मधील जगज्ज्योती । जगज्ज्योतीच्या अनंत मूर्ती । देवदेवतांच्या ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण ज्याला वारा म्हणतो तो वायूचा एक प्रकार आहे. तो सर्वांना माहीत आहे. ज्यास जगत् ज्योति म्हणतात तो दुसरा प्रकार होय. सर्व देव-देवता  जगत्-ज्योतिच्या अनंत मूर्ति आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: That One is the Knower of this wind and that One within this wind is also this `light of the world' (He is His reflection). Therefore there is that endless paramatma and there is this `I am' of knowledge that comes from this union of prakruti/purush.

owis.original: वायो बहुत विकारला । परंतु दों प्रकारें विभागला । आतां विचार ऐकिला । पाहिजे तेजाचा ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वायूचे विकार पुष्कळ आढळले तरी त्याचे मुख्य प्रकार देनच आहेत. यानंतर तेजाचे प्रकार ऐकावे.
owis.englishMeaning: Then this wind of the `all' (prakruti/purush) modified further divided into two forms and that thoughtless Self appeared as the fire element. Therefore you should listen now (by listening one becomes less objective).

owis.original: वायोपासून तेज जालें । उष्ण सीतळ प्रकाशलें । द्विविध रुप ऐकिलें । पाहिजे तेजाचें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वायूपासून तेज निर्माण झाले. उष्ण व थंड अशा दोन प्रकारांनी तें अनुभवास येतें. तेजाचे हे दोन प्रकार आतां ऐकावें.
owis.englishMeaning: From the wind, the fire has come and then hot and cold appeared. One should listen to these two forms of fire (the wind is knowing, whatever comes, comes and whatever goes, goes but it doesn't care for `nothing is there'; fire is a little more objective and it is the beginning of an external world, `something is outside of myself' but forms and names have not yet appeared)

owis.original: उष्णापासून जाला भानु । प्रकाशरुप दैदीप्यमानु । सर्वभक्षक हुताशनु । आणी विद्युल्यता ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रकाशरुप व अत्यंत तेजोमय असा सूर्य उष्णापासून झाला. त्याचप्रमाणें सर्व भक्षण करणारा अग्नि आणि वीज दोन्ही उष्णापासून निे्माण झाली.
owis.englishMeaning: From the hot form, the sun appears and this is exceeding bright and it is the nature of light. From this hot form, there is this fire that consumes the `I am' and the great piles of many things. And from this hot form there is lightning. (Previously there was no such thing as light or darkness, there was only this spontaneous knowing of the `all'. This knowing becomes a little more objective and then there is a sun and it sheds its light and reveals a creation outside of myself. This fire can play a dual role. It destroys this `I am everywhere' feeling, for due to this a sun appears and a world outside is illuminated and this `I am' feeling disappears ie. becoming a little become more objective. But also when this fire element is know then, the many gross objects get destroyed, for this fire element is less objective than the water and earth elements. And the lightning is the momentary flashes in the darkness. It is the mind that knows something has appeared. But it does not decide what it is. That is left up to the buddhi; and when he decides what it is, then it becomes more objective and that appears)

owis.original: सीतळापासून आप अमृत । चंद्र तारा आणी सीत । आतां परिसा सावचित्त । होऊन श्रोते ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: थंड किंवा शीतल तेजापासून पाणी, अमृत,चंद्रमा, तारका आणि थंडी हे निर्माण झाले. आतां श्रोत्यांनीं लक्ष देऊन ऐकावें.
owis.englishMeaning: From the cold there comes the water (ie. a little more objective) and also that immortal nectar. And then there is the moon, the stars and the planets. Therefore now, that listener is to listen with a pure chitta. (The objective world is beginning to appear because the buddhi decides what it is that the mind knows and begins naming and creating objects. Then the objects of the material universe start to appear. Still this water is less objective than the earth element and if it is understood then, one can become less and less objective until that `all' is understood. This is the immortal nectar, for as long as this `all' is known, one cannot die)

owis.original: तेज बहुत विकारलें । परंतु द्विविधान बोलिलें । आपहि द्विविधाच निरोपिलें । आप आणि अमृत ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तेजाचे विकार बरेच असले तरी त्याचे मुख्य प्रकार दोनच आहेत. पाण्याचे प्रकार देखील मुख्यतः दोनच आहेत. ते म्हणजे पाणी व अमृत होय. ते सांगून झालेच आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: The fire is a modification of this `I am' but in truth, its two forms are this `I am' feeling. These two forms of water will also be explained. They are water and that immortal nectar (due to the water, the world starts to appear and when that water goes back to its source, it is that immortal nectar).

owis.original: ऐकें पृथ्वीचा विचार । पाषाण मृत्तिका निरंतर । आणीक दुसरा प्रकार । सुवर्ण परीस नाना रत्नें ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आतां पृथ्वीचे प्रकार ऐकावे. दगड व माती हा नेहमीच्या अनुभवाचा प्रकार आणि सोनें, परीस व अनेक प्रकारची रत्नें हा दुसरा प्रकार होय.
owis.englishMeaning: By listening carefully this earth element 2 of stones and dirt becomes that parabrahman and then these `many' jewels are the gold of the paris stone (ie. philosopher's stone that is said to turn iron into gold ie. `all').

owis.original: बहुरत्ना वसुंधरा । कोण खोटा कोण खरा । अवघें कळे विचारा-। रुढ होतां ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बहुरत्ना वसुंधरा असें म्हणतात. रत्न खरें कोणतें व खोटें कोणतें हें समजलें पाहिजेम. माणसानें विचार केला म्हणजे ते त्यास समजते.
owis.englishMeaning: But when there are these `many jewels' and this earth element then, how can it be determined what is false and what is true? However when everything is that undivided thoughtless Self then, one has acquired wisdom. (When one is captivated by this world of many forms and many wealths then, the mind wanders here and there and cannot think with vivek. But when one only listens to this `I am', then these elements return to their source).

owis.original: मनुष्यें कोठून जालीं । हे मुख्य आशंका राहिली । पुढें वृत्ति सावध केली । पाहिजे श्रोतीं ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असो. माणसें कोठून आली ? ही मुख्य शंका अजून तशीच राहिली आहे. तिचे निरसन ऐकण्यास श्रोत्यांनी मन सावध करावें.
owis.englishMeaning: From where can the human bodies appear when this `I am' remains as that thoughtless Reality (how can there be body consciousness when there is that thoughtless Reality)? Therefore ahead, the listener should be alert and create this knowing vritti. Note: The modern science of relative and quantum physics also concludes that that which appears to be solid and separate is in fact, at a sub-atomic level, interconnected inseparable particles of energy. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Bija Lakshan (The Nature of the Seed)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: आतां पाहों जातां उत्पत्ती । मनुष्यांपासून मनुष्यें होती । पशुपासून पशु निपजती । प्रत्यक्ष आतां ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणूस कसा निर्माण होतो, हे बघितलें तर माणूस माणसापासून जन्मतो , व पशुपासून पशु निपजतो. असें प्रत्यक्ष दिसते.
owis.englishMeaning: The understanding of this `now' is destroyed when you try to see this gross creation. Then from human being, more human bodies are created and from animals, animals are produced and this `now' (ie. knowledge) sees through the sense organs (and there is a past, present and future).

owis.original: खेचरें आणी भूचरें । वनचरें आणी जळचरें । नाना प्रकारीचीं शरीरें । शेरीरांपासून होती ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आकाशांत उडणारे पक्षी, पृथ्वीवर चालणारे प्राणी, जंगलांतील प्राणी, पाण्यांतील जलचर, अशीं नाना प्रकारची शरीरें आहेत. परंतु ती सगळीं दुसर्‍या शरीरापासूनच निर्माण होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Then there are creatures which fly and creatures walking on this earth and creatures of the forest and water. Then from this body of the `all', many kinds of bodies appear.

owis.original: प्रत्यक्षास आणी प्रमाण । निश्र्चयास आणि अनुमान । मार्ग देखोन आडरान । घेऊंच नये ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें प्रत्यक्ष आहे त्यास आणखीं पुरावा लागत नाहीं. जी गोष्ट निश्र्चित असते तेथें तर्क चालत नाहीं. अर्थात समोर सरळ रस्ता दिसत असतां माणसांनीं आडरानांत शिरु नये.
owis.englishMeaning: Can there be Truth and sensory experience? Can there be conjecture and conviction? Having been shown the road of Truth and conviction, why should one take these by- lanes?

owis.original: विपरीतापासून विपरीतें होती । परी शरीरेंच बोलिजेती । शरीरावांचून उत्पत्ती । होणार नाहीं ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विचित्र व विलक्षण शरीरापासून तशीच विचित्र व विलक्षण शरीरें निर्माण होतात. पण त्यांना शरीरच म्हणतात. तात्पर्य शरीराशिवाय शरीराची उत्पत्ती होणें शक्य नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: From false knowledge (rajo guna), the false appears but still there is this `speech' by the `all' body. Without this body, there can be no birth of a gross body. (Because of body consciousness this `all' body cannot be perceived. But this does not mean it does not exist. It gives power to this `dead' body)

owis.original: तरी हे उत्पत्ति कैसी जाली । कासयाची कोणें केली । जेणें केली त्याची निर्मिली । काया कोणें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: येथें असें प्रश्र्ण निर्माण होतात कीं, शरीराची उत्पत्ती कशी झाली ? ती कोणी केली ? कशापासून केली ? ज्यानें शरीराची उत्पत्ती केली त्याचे शरीर कोणी निर्माण केले ?
owis.englishMeaning: When you understand this `speech' then, how can that thoughtless Self take a birth in this gross existence? Then *who could make That take birth and how? When this `speech' has created this `all' then, why to create a gross body? *(See 9.7.26; we only and no one else are responsible for our taking another birth)

owis.original: ऐसें पाहातां उदंड लांबलें । परी मुळीं शेरीर कैसें जालें । कासयाचें उभारिलें । कोणें कैसें ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या प्रश्र्नाचे उत्तर देतांना एकानें दुसर्‍याचें व दुसर्‍यानें तिसर्‍याचें असें म्हटलें व कितीही मागें गेलें तरी पहिलें शरीर कसें निर्माण झालें हा प्रश्र्ण राहतोच. तसेंच तेम कसहाचें बनवलें व कोणी निर्माण केलें हें प्रश्र्ण अनुत्तरींतच राहतात.
owis.englishMeaning: But when you believe that there is this `all' then, that vast paramatma has expanded outwards. But tell me, at the root why should this `all' body even appear? For is there anyone to create anything, anywhere? (There is only that One paramatma and He is not a creator; all the rest is doubt and imaginings)

owis.original: ऐसी हे मागील आशंका । राहात गेली ते ऐका । कदापी जाजु घेऊं नका । प्रत्ययो आलियानें ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मागील शंका ही अशी आहे. तिला ुत्तर देण्याचें राहून गेलें. असो. प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव आल्यावर मात्र उगाच भलताच तर्क करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: But it seems this previous doubt still persists, therefore listen (the only means to truly directly understand the Truth is to remain in this listening. Then questions, doubt and this `speech' will disappear). And when that understanding of nirgun comes then, one should never again accept this false claim of `I am'.

owis.original: प्रत्ययोचि आहे प्रमाण । मूर्खास वाटे अप्रमाण । पिंडें प्रमायचितशब्दें जाण । विश्र्वासासी ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव हाच खरा पुरावा समजावा. मूर्खाला तो पटत नाहीं. प्रचीति म्हटली म्हणजे सामान्य माणसाला विश्र्वास उत्पन्न होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The understanding of nirgun is the Truth/authority, but the foolish still continue to sift through the untrue/unauthorized. Know that both the pinda and the `experience' of this `word' depend on where you place your faith. (maharaj- when you know that you have one hundred thousand dollars in the bank, then what faith is required; you know no!)

owis.original: ब्रह्मीं मूळमाया जाली । तेचि अष्टधा प्रकृति बोलिली । भूतीं त्रिगुणीं कालवली । मूळमाया ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परब्रह्माच्या ठिकाणीं मूळमाया निर्माण झाली. तिलाच पुढें अष्टधा प्रकृति असें नांव दिलें. पांच भूतें व तीन गुण अशी आठ तत्वें मूळमायेमध्यें कालवलेली असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When in brahman, mula maya appears then, that Reality has appeared as this `speech' of the eightfold prakruti. And then this prakruti gets mixed within these elements and gunas.

owis.original: ते मूळमाया वायोस्वरुप । वायोमध्यें जाणीवेचें रुप । तेचि इच्छा परी आरोप । ब्रह्मीं न घडे ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मूळमाया वायुस्वरुप आहे. शक्तिमय आहे. वायूमध्यें जाणिवेचें जें रुप असतें तीच इच्छा होय. परंतु परब्रह्मावर तीला लादता येत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: mula maya means this wind along with that swarup and in this wind, this `all' form is known. It is that Reality appearing as this original wish to be. But in brahman this accusation `I am' has never been made.

owis.original: तथापि ब्रह्मीं कल्पिला । तरी तो शब्द वायां गेला । आत्मा निर्गुण संचला । शब्दातीत ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शुद्ध ब्रह्माच्या ठिकाणीं इच्छेची कल्पना केली तर ती वाया जाते, कारण ब्रह्म निर्विकल्प आहे. आत्मरुपानें तें निर्गुण व शब्दातीत स्वरुप सगळीकडे भरुन राहीले आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When this original wish is imagined within brahman then, that atma purush becomes this empty `word'. Still beyond this `word', that nirgun atma alone exists.

owis.original: आत्मा निर्गुण वस्तु ब्रह्म । नाममात्र तितुका भ्रम । कल्पून लाविला संभ्रम । तरी तो लागणार नाहीं ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वास्तविक सद्वस्तु मानवी कल्पना व भाषा यांच्या आवाक्याबाहेर आहे. आत्मा, निर्गुण, वस्तु, ब्रह्म अशी नांवें भ्रमात्मक आहेत. आपण आपल्या कल्पनेनें त्यांच्यावर नावें लादली तरी ती भ्रामक नावें सद्वस्तुच्या स्वरुपाला स्पर्श करणार नाहीत.
owis.englishMeaning: The atma is nirgun and it can be called the Self or brahman. And this `name', this much only is the delusion. And due to this imagined `name', confusion grew and spread far abroad (if the base is ignorance then what comes from ignorance cannot be true). Still that atma is not affected.

owis.original: तथापि आग्रहें लाविला । जरी धोंडा मारिला आकाशाला । आकाशावरी कुंथिला । तरी तें तुटेना ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: समजा एखाद्या माणसानें आकाशांत धोंडा मारला किंवा तो आकाशावर थुंकला तरी त्यांचा स्पर्श आकाशाला होणार नाहीं. त्याचप्रमाणें एखाद्यानें आग्रहानें अगर हट्टानें ब्रह्मास नांव दिलें तरी तें त्यास चिकटणार नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Even if one persists in applying this `name' to that atma, still it is like throwing a stone at the space. And even when strenuous efforts are made within this space, still that Reality is not broken.

owis.original: तैसें ब्रह्म निर्विकार । निर्विकारीं लाविती विकार । विकार नामे निर्विकार । जैसें तैसें ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तसें ब्रह्म अत्यंत विकारमुक्त आहे. जें विकाररहित आहे त्यास विकार चिकटवण्याचा प्रयत्न केला तर विकार गळून पडतात. व मूळ ब्रह्म मात्र जसेंच्या तसें राहते.
owis.englishMeaning: Like this is that unmodified brahman. In the unmodified, modifications may be applied but the modifications are destroyed and the unmodified is, just as It is.

owis.original: आतां ऐका प्रत्ययो । जाणोनि धरावा निश्र्चयो । तरीच पाविजे जयो । अनुभवाचा ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आतां ऐकावें. अनुभव समजुन घ्यावा. मगआपलें मत निश्र्चित करावें. असें केलें तरच साक्षात् अनुभव येईल.
owis.englishMeaning: Now listen and there will be that nirgun understanding. For by constantly knowing, this thoughtless conviction can be formed and then only, can this `experience' be transcen- ded.

owis.original: मायाब्रह्मीं जो समीर । त्यांत जाणता तो ईश्र्वर । ईश्र्वर आणि सर्वेश्र्वर । तयासीच बोलिजे ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मूळमाया निर्माण झाली म्हणजे परब्रह्माच्या एका भागावर ती वावरते. तेथें " मी ब्रह्म आहे " असें ज्ञानमय भान किंवा शुद्ध जाणीव प्रगट होते. त्या जाणिवेच्या अधिष्ठान ब्रह्माला ईश्र्वर असें म्हणतात. ईश्र्वर आणी परमेश्र्वर ही दोन्ही त्याचीच नांवें आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: maya is a breeze in that brahman. The Knower in this maya is called ishwara/purush and therefore that ishwara should be called the Lord of this `all'.

owis.original: तोचि ईश्र्वर गुणासी आला । त्याचा त्रिगुणभेद जाला । ब्रह्मा विष्णु महेश उपजला । तये ठाईं ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्या ईश्र्वराचा गुणांशी संबंध येतो. मग त्रिगुण भेदानें त्याला तीन अंगें दिसतात. सत्त्वाचे अंग विष्णु, रजाचे अंग ब्रह्मदेव व तमाचें अंग महेश होय. ईश्र्वराचे ठिकाणीं ही तीन अंगें दिसली तरी अखेर ईश्र्वर एकच राहतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That ishwara who gave rise to these three gunas has appeared as these three distinct gunas. Then to that Reality there has appeared this place where brahma, vishnu and mahesh are produced (ie. the dream, sleep and waking states).

owis.original: सत्व रज आणि तम । हे त्रिगुण उत्तमोत्तम । यांच्या स्वरुपाचा अनुक्रम । मागां निरोपिला ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सत्त्व, रज व तम हे तीन गुण उत्तमांत उत्तम गुण आहेत. त्यांच्या स्वरुपाचें वर्णन मागें सांगून झालें आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is sattwa, raja and tama then, that thoughtless and best of the best is these three gunas. But previous to these three gunas there is this `speech', and previous to this there is that nirgun swarup.

owis.original: जाणता विष्णू भगवान । जाणतानेणता चतुरानन । नेणता महेश पंचानन । अत्यंत भोळा ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणता सत्त्वमय तो विष्णु, जाणतानेणता रजोमय तो चार तोंडांचा ब्रह्मदेव, आणि नेणता तमोमय तो पांच तोंडांचा अत्यंत भोळा शंकर होय.
owis.englishMeaning: Knowing is this mighty lord vishnu. Knowing and not-knowing is brahma, with his four faces (ie. four kinds of birth); and the one who does not know is mahesh, with five faces (ie. from tamo guna ie. ignorance, comes the five great elements). He is extremely forgetful (the moment something appears it is forgotten; maharaj- you have to forget the word you have just heard if you are to hear the next word)

owis.original: त्रिगुण त्रिगुणीं कालवले । कैसे होती वेगळाले । परी विशेष न्यून भासले । ते बोलावे लागती ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तीन गुण एकमेकांत कालवलेले असतात. ते वेगळे करतां येत नाहीत. पण जेव्हां एखादा गुण अधिक आढळतो किंवा कमी दिसतो तेव्हां त्या दृष्टीनें गुणांच्याबद्दल सांगावें लागतें.
owis.englishMeaning: When these three gunas get mixed with one another then, how can they be separated out? Then that pure sattwa appears as something defective (see V.4). Therefore one should start speaking this `speech' and unravel these mixed gunas.

owis.original: वायोमध्यें विष्णू होता । तो वायोस्वरुपचि तत्वता । पुढें जाला देहधर्ता । चतुर्भुजु ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उदा. मूळमायेमधील जाणीवेमध्यें सत्त्वमय विष्णु होता. खरें म्हणजे तो जाणीवस्वरुप होता. नंतर त्यानें चार हात असलेला देह धारण केला.
owis.englishMeaning: Within this wind, vishnu has appeared yet truly there is only this wind and that swarup (ie. prakruti/purush). It is later that, that one with four arms appears as a holder of a body (when there is this wind and swarup then, witnessing is there; then vishnu, this sattwa guna appears and when you take body consciousness, it is this sattwa that is knowing).

owis.original: तैसाच ब्रह्मा आणि महेश । देह धरिती सावकास । गुप्त प्रगट होतां तयांस । वेळ नाहीं ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याचप्रमाणें ब्रह्मदेव आणि शंकर मूळ जाणीवेमध्यें असतात. नंतर योग्य काळीं तें दोघे देह धारण करतात. देहानें प्रगट होण्यास व देह सोडून गुप्त होण्यास त्यांना वेळ लागत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: brahma and mahesh also appeared and then that effortless One is the holder of a body (ie. jiva). But that hidden purush is revealed as soon as body consciousness is given up.

owis.original: आतां रोकडी प्रचिती । मनुष्यें गुप्त प्रगटती । मां त्या देवांच्याच मूर्ती । सामर्थ्यवंत ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसेंसुद्धा गुप्त होतात व प्रगट होतात. असा प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव आपणांस येतो. मगब्रह्मा, विष्णु व महेश या तर देवांच्या मूर्ति आहेत. त्यांच्या अंगी सामर्थ्य असणारच.
owis.englishMeaning: If a man thinks clearly then, that concealed purush within this ever present `experience' is revealed and then that man is the purush. Then He is the possessor of His power and the Lord of this `all'.

owis.original: देव देवता भूतें देवतें । चढतें सामर्थ्य आहे तेथें । येणेंचि न्यायें राक्षसांतें । सामर्थ्यकळा ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देव, देवता, भुतें आणि दैवतें यांच्या ठिकाणी अधिकाधिक असें चढतें सामर्थ्य असतें. याच न्यायानें राक्षसांच्या सामर्थ्याचा देखील एखादा काळ असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: There is God/purush, there is the goddess/prakruti, there are the great elements and the deities (ie. gunas). By ascending higher and higher, this power reaches `there'/brahman. And on account of that brahman, there is the demon of ignorance and this `art' of knowledge.

owis.original: झोटिंग वायोस्वरुप असती । सवेंच खुळखुळां चालती । खोबरीं खारिका टाकून देती । अकस्मात ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: झोटिंग ही योनी वायुस्वरुप असतें. तो दिसत नाहीं पण त्याचा चालण्याचा खुळखुळ असा आवाज येतो. झोटिंग अकस्मात आपल्या पुढ्यांत खोबरें, खारीक टाकून देतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Ghosts are within union of this wind and that swarup and they move about noisily of their own accord, leaving behind such things as dates or pieces of coconut (actually to ward off ghosts people place dates and pieces of coconut, so maybe we are the ghosts that swami ramdas refers to)

owis.original: अवघेंचि न्याल अभावें । तरी हें बहुतेकांस ठावें । आपुल्याला अनुभवें । विश्र्वलोक जाणती ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: यावर विक्ष्वास न ठेवतां हें सारें खोटें आहे असें कोणी म्हणेल. पण हें घडतें ही गोष्ट पुष्कळांना माहित आहे. पुष्कळांना असें अनुभव आलेलें असल्यानें सगळ्या लोकांना हें प्रकार माहीत आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: When such things are taken as false then, that thoughtless swarup can know its own Self (ghosts etc. are all the tricks of imagination, just like this body). But first through this `experience', you come to know this world as your own.

owis.original: मनुष्यें धरिती शरीरवेष । नाना परकाया प्रवेश । मां तो परमात्मा जगदीश । कैसा न धरी ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसें वेगवेगळीं शरीरें व वेष धारण करतात. परकायाप्रवेश करतात. मग तो जगाचा नियंता परमेश्र्वर शरीर धारण कां करणार नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When a man holds this covering of the `all' firmly (ie. when he forgets everything) then, that gross body enters this `all' body. Then, why can that paramatma who is the Lord of the world, not also be the holder this body? (Having understood this `all', now understand it is that paramatma who has appeared as this `all' and you do not exist)

owis.original: म्हणोनि वायोस्वरुपें देह धरिलें । ब्रह्मा विष्णु महेश जाले । पुढें तेचि विस्तारलें । पुत्रपौत्रीं ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून वायुस्वरुप जाणीवेनें जे देह धरले तेच ब्रह्मा विष्णु आणि महेश झाले. पुढें मुलें, नातवंडे असा त्यांचा विस्तार होत गेला.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this wind and that swarup, the `all' body was held and brahma, vishnu and mahesh appeared (first there was this `all' body and when that was forgotten, there appeared the subtle and gross bodies created by the gunas. Then you know something is there/sattwa but you don't know what it is/tama and you give it a name/raja). And afterwards, that Reality became the expansion of many sons and grandsons (having taken yourself as a gross body, there comes the `many' thoughts of my family, children, grandchildren, ancestry etc.).

owis.original: अंतरींच स्त्रिया कल्पिल्या । तों त्या कल्पितंच निर्माण जाल्या । परी तयापासून प्रजा निर्मिल्या । नाहींत कदा ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्यांनीं मनांत स्त्रियांची कल्पना केली. त्याबरोबर स्त्रिया निर्माण झाल्या. पण त्या ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, महेश यांनीं त्या स्त्रिायांपासून प्रजा निर्माण केली नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: First this woman called prakruti was imagined in this inner space. That paramatma imagined Himself and she was created. But her progeny of the gunas and elements and the many objects have not been created from that paramatma (these are created from prakruti)

owis.original: इछून पुत्र कल्पिले । ते ते प्रसंगीं निर्माण जाले । येणें प्रकारें वर्तले । हरिहरादिक ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पुत्र असावा अशा इच्छेनें पुत्राची कल्पना करतांच निरनिराळ्या प्रसंगीं पुत्र निर्माण झाले. याप्रमाणें ब्रह्मा, विष्णु व महेश वागले.
owis.englishMeaning: She had only wished to be and to know but then, her sons (gunas and elements) were imagined and that Reality within this `all' appeared as these sons. Then that thoughtless Self appeared as hari (vishnu), hara (mahesh) and brahma.

owis.original: पुढें ब्रह्मयानें सृष्टी कल्पिली । इछेसरिसी सृष्टी जाली । जीवसृष्टि निर्माण केली । ब्रह्मदेवें ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नंतर ब्रह्मदेवानें विश्वाची कल्पना केली लगेच इच्छेप्रमाणें विश्व निर्माण झालें. या विश्वांतील सर्व प्राणी ब्रह्मदेवानेंच निर्माण केलें.
owis.englishMeaning: After, a gross creation was imagined by brahma (ie. buddhi- the naming of this and that) and then in the company of this wish to be and to know, the gross world appeared. In this way, the gross world of the jiva has been created by lord brahma. (Everything from this knowledge to the gross creation have appeared through imagination and then the jiva says, "I am and I know")

owis.original: नाना प्रकारीचे प्राणी कल्पिले । इछेसरिसे निर्माण जाले । अवघे जोडेचि उदेले । अंडजजारजादिक ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्यानें अनेक प्रकारच्या प्राण्यांची कल्पना करतांच तें प्राणी ताबडतोप निर्माण झालें. अंडज, जारज असें प्राणी नरमादी अशा जोडीनें प्रगट झालें.
owis.englishMeaning: These ways of the `many' in the prana have been imagined and they have appeared in the company of this `wish' to be. Then pairs of everything, male and female, arose and there was the four kinds of birth. One kind is born from the egg and the second kind is from the womb.

owis.original: येक जळस्वेदापासून जाले । ते प्राणी स्वेदज बोलिले । येक वायोकरितां जाले । अकस्मात उद्बिज ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा प्रकारे जे प्राणी घाम व पाणी यापासून निर्माण झालें त्यांना स्वेदज म्हणतात. जे जीवप्राणी वायूपासून निर्माण झालें त्यांना उद्भिज म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the third kind then, that One appears from the water of sweat. First that Reality became this `speech' and then it takes a birth in the prana from the warm sweat (micro-organisms, virus etc.). And the fourth kind of birth is when that One, on account to this wind of `I am', suddenly appears as a sprouting seed.

owis.original: मनुष्याची गौडविद्या । राक्षसांची वोडंबरीविद्या । ब्रह्मयाची सृष्टिविद्या । येणें प्रकारें ॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसें जादुनें वस्तु निर्माण करतात.तेव्हां तिला गौडविद्या म्हणतात. राक्षसांच्या वस्तु निर्माण करण्याच्या विद्येला वोडंबरी म्हणतात. तर ब्रह्मदेवाच्या निर्माण करण्याच्या विद्येला सृष्टिविद्या म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When that One takes a human birth then, thoughtlessness has become the *imaginati- ons of a human being and the empty show that is the magic of the demon (ie. ignorance) and the knowledge of a world that was been created by brahma (ie. buddhi of man). (These three are rajo guna, tamo guna and sattwa guna respectively) *(He is good and this is bad etc. many differing individual concepts that maintain this continuity of being a body)

owis.original: कांहींयेक मनुष्यांची । त्याहून विशेष राक्षेसांची । त्याहून विशेष ब्रह्मयाची । सृष्टिविद्या ॥ ३५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसांची गौडविद्या कांहीं थोड्या वस्तु निर्माण करते, तर राक्षसांची वोडंबरीविद्या त्याहून थोड्याअधिक वस्तु निर्माण कते. पण ब्रह्मदेवांची सृष्टिविद्या त्या दोन्हीविद्यांहून अधिक वस्तु निर्माण करते. विश्वामधील सर्व वस्तु ती निर्माण करते.
owis.englishMeaning: From that One within this `thing' there has come this rajo guna of a man; from that pure knowledge there has come this tamo guna of the demon and from that pure knowledge there has come the sattwa guna that has knowledge of this world created by brahma.

owis.original: जाणते नेणते प्राणी निर्मिले । वेद वदोन मार्ग लाविले । ब्रह्मयानें निर्माण केले । येणें प्रकारें ॥ ३६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्मदेवानें जाणते  व नेणते दोन्ही प्रकारचे प्राणी निर्माण केले. वेद निर्माण करुन जीवनांत वागण्याचा मार्ग दाखवून दिल. ब्रह्मदेवानें अशाप्रकारें प्राणी निर्माण केले.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to knowing and not knowing, that One becomes a man in the prana and by the study of the vedas (ie. neti, neti) he sets out on this path of `I am'. This creation that has been made by brahma is imagined due to knowing and not knowing.

owis.original: मग शरीरांपासून शरीरें । सृष्टि वाढली विकारें । सकळ शरीरें येणें प्रकारें । निर्माण जालीं ॥ ३७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सृष्टि निर्माण झाल्यावर मग शरीरापासून शरीरें निर्माण झाली. आणि सृष्टिचा विस्तार झाला. अशाप्रकारें सगळीं शरीरें निर्माण झाली.
owis.englishMeaning: From this body of the `all' there has come the bodies of the `many'. This gross creation has expanded from this `all' modification and this `all' and the body of the `many' have been created due to this unmodified thoughtless Self.

owis.original: येथें आशंका फिटली । सकळ सृष्टि विस्तारली । विचार पाहातां प्रत्यया आली । येथान्वयें ॥ ३८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: येथें शंका फिटली. सगळीकडे सृष्टि विस्तार पावली ती कशी  यावर तिच्या विस्ताराचा  क्रम प्रत्यक्ष अनुभवास आला.
owis.englishMeaning: When this doubt `here' is not held firmly then, this `all' spreads out and there is this gross creation. And when one understands thoughtlessness, then accordingly that understanding of nirgun comes. (To be the `all' body is a doubt for the One beyond any bodies. But when this `all' is not held firmly then, there so many kinds of doubts arise)

owis.original: ऐसी सृष्टि निर्माण केली । पुढें विष्णूनें कैसी प्रतिपाळिली । हेहि विवंचना पाहिली । पाहिजे श्रोतीं ॥ ३९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्मदेवानें सृष्ति निर्माण केली पण ती विष्णुनें सांभाळली कशी, त्यानें तिचे प्रतिपालन कसें केलें ह्याचेही विवेचन श्रोत्यांनी समजलें पाहिजे.
owis.englishMeaning: When this gross creation has been formed then, how can vishnu nourish and protect it after (how can one be the knowing of vishnu when there are the imagining of the buddhi and the `many' concepts and questions etc.)? And how will that thoughtless investigation within the listener be understood?

owis.original: सकळ प्राणी निर्माण जाले । ते मूळरुपें जाणोन पाळिले । शरीरें दैत्य निर्दाळिले । नाना प्रकारींचें ॥ ४० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्व प्राणी निर्माण झाले, त्यांच्याजवळ जणीव आहे. जाणीव विष्णूचें मूळरुप आहे. त्या शुद्ध जाणिवेनें सर्व प्राण्यांचें पालन होतें. त्या जाणीवेनें प्रत्यक्ष शरीर धारण करुन अनेक राक्षसांना मारुन टाकलें.
owis.englishMeaning: Whenever that Reality has appeared in the prana then, it is known and protected by this original form (`I am'). Due to this body of the `all', the ways of the `many' devils (ie. objects) are utterly destroyed by this sadhana of just knowing.

owis.original: नाना अवतार धरणें । दुष्टांचा संहार करणें । धर्म स्थापयाकारणें । विष्णूस जन्म ॥ ४१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दुष्टांचा संहार करण्यासाठीं ती विष्णूरुप मूळची शुद्ध जाणीव अनेक अवतार धारण करतें. धर्माची स्थापना करण्यासाठीं विष्णूला जन्म घ्यावें लागतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When the `many' thoughts hold this incarnation of vishnu firmly in the mind (forgets everything and knowing naturally there) then, these evil and corrupt, willful and un- controlled thoughts are destroyed. And then due to this knowing, vishnu takes birth in the mind and it becomes a place of dharma (inherent quality or duty ie. to know only).

owis.original: म्हणोन धर्मस्थापनेचे नर । तेंहि विष्णूचे अवतार । अभक्त दुर्जन रजनीचर । सहजचि जाले ॥ ४२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या दृष्टिनें धर्माची स्थापना करणारे सुद्धां विष्णुचे अवतार होत. अर्थात जे अभक्त व दुर्जन असतात ते राक्षस समजावेत.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore when a man has become this place of dharma (ie. knowledge) then, he is called an incarnation of vishnu (ie. *avatar). But a non-devotee is `far from the atma' and then that natural swarup moves around only at night, in the darkness of ignorance. *(maharaj- `avatar means to have come down'; You have left your swarup)

owis.original: आतां प्राणी जे जन्मले । ते नेणोन संव्हारले । मूळरुपें संव्हारिलें । येणें प्रकारें ॥ ४३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आतां जे प्राणी जन्माला येतात. त्यांचा नेणीवेनें संव्हार होतो. ज्याप्रमाणें मूळ विष्णुरुप जाणीव प्राण्यांचे पालन करते. त्याचप्रमाणें मूळ रुद्ररुप नेणीव प्राण्यांचा संहार करते.
owis.englishMeaning: Whatever takes birth in the prana gets destroyed due to its ignorance. And due to this, this original form (knowledge) gets destroyed (Every night we get destroyed; when you sleep, where is this knowing? maharaj- sleep is a small death).

owis.original: शरीरें रुद्र खवळेल । तैं जीवसृष्टि संव्हारेल । अवघें ब्रह्मांडचि जळेल । संव्हारकाळीं ॥ ४४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्व प्राण्यांच्या शरीरांतील रुद्र जेव्हां खवळतो त्यावेळीं सारी जीवसृष्टि नाश पावते. यावेळीं सर्व विश्व जळून जाते.
owis.englishMeaning: Then rudra (he forgets everything) has been awakened and the gross world of the jiva will be burnt. And at this time of the destruction, everything in the brahmanda will be completely burnt.

owis.original: एवं उत्पत्ती संव्हार । याचा ऐसा आहे विचार । श्रोतीं होऊन ततपर । अवधान द्यावें ॥ ४५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उत्पत्ति, स्थिति व संहार यांचें विवेचन याप्रमाणें सांगून झालें. श्रोत्यांनी पुढें लक्ष देऊन ऐकावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Thus the creation, maintenance and destruction of this gross world, has come from this `speech' of that thoughtless Self. Therefore the true listener is to give his full attention and be absorbed in this `speech'.

owis.original: कल्पांतीं संव्हार घडेल । तोचि पुढे सांगिजेल । पंचप्रळय वोळखेल । तोचि ज्ञानी ॥ ४६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कल्पान्ती जो संहार होतो तो पुढील समासांत सांगणार आहे. पांच प्रकारचे प्रलय जो ओळखतो तोच खरा ज्ञानी होय.
owis.englishMeaning: Then there will be the end of imagination and the dissolution of creation. Then after- wards that paramatma will be understood. The one who can recognize this dissolution of the five elements is called a gnyani. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Panchapralaya Nirupan (A Discourse on the Five Dissolutions)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: ऐका प्रळयाचें लक्षण । पिंडीं दोनी प्रळये जाण । येकनिद्रा येक मरण । देहांतकाळ ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आतां प्रलयाचे लक्षण ऐका. पिंडामध्यें दोन प्रलय असतात. पहिला म्हणजे गाढ झोप आणि दुसरा म्हणजे मरण किंवा देहान्त, मृत्यु होय.
owis.englishMeaning: Listen (ie. forget everything), for this attention will bring about dissolution of the whole creation. But first know what the two dissolutions within the body/pinda are called. One is sleep and the other is death (maharaj- sleep is a small death)

owis.original: देहधारक तिनी मूर्ती । निद्रा जेव्हां संपादिती । तो निद्राप्रळय श्रोतीं । ब्रह्मांडीचा जाणावा ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्मांडांतसुद्धा दोन प्रलय असतात. ब्रह्मा, विष्णु व महेश या देह धारण केलेल्या देवता जेव्हां झोपीं जातात, तेव्हां ब्रह्मांडाचा निद्राप्रलय सुरु असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: And when that holder of this body (ie. jiva; then there is vishnu/knowing, brahma/conceptualizing intellect and mahesh/not knowing) created by the three gunas goes to sleep then, that should be know as the dissolution of the brahmanda by sleep (the third dissolution. If through understanding, the three gunas are dropped then, the brahma/buddhi sleeps and as he is the creator of the brahmanda, the created universe disappears along with the jiva).

owis.original: तिनी मूर्तीस होईल अंत । ब्रह्मांडास मांडेल कल्पांत । तेव्हां जाणावा नेमस्त । ब्रह्मप्रळये जाला ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या तिन्ही देहधारी देवतांचा जेव्हां अंत होतो, त्यावेळीं ब्रह्मांडाचा कल्पान्तकाल सुरु होतो. तेव्हां ब्रह्मप्रलय होऊ लागला असें समजावें.
owis.englishMeaning: And when brahma/intellect comes to an end then, the brahmanda will be destroyed (when the buddhi dies then, there one will be established in the `all' and a world seen through the senses will no longer exist). And finally when there comes the end of all thought then, one should clearly know that the great dissolution has come (ie. the fifth dissolution).

owis.original: दोनी पिंडी दोनी ब्रह्मांडीं । च्यारी प्रळय नवखंडीं । पांचवा प्रळय उदंडी । जाणिजे विवेकाचा ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या नवखंड परुथ्वीवर पिंडाचे दोन व ब्रह्मांडाचे दोन असे चार प्रलय व पांचवा प्रलय विवेकाचा आहे. तो अतिशय महत्वाचा व सर्वोत्तम आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Thus there are two dissolutions in the pinda and two in the brahmanda. These are the four dissolutions within the nine continents (ie. five elements and four bodies). The fifth dissolution takes place within that paramatma and should be known as the dissolution by vivek. (Sleep and death bring about the dissolution of the pinda. At these times this pinda is shouded in ignorance. And when knowledge once again awakens from sleep then, on account of our thoughts, the pinda/individual body once again appears. But when one makes vivek then, the pinda and brahmanda are destroyed and this `all' is experienced. This is proper meditation. And by further vivek this `all' or `I am' dissolves and that One paramatma remains. This is know as the dissolution of creation by vivek)

owis.original: ऐसे हे पांचहि प्रळये । सांगितले येथान्वयें । आतां हें अनुभवास ये । ऐसें करुं ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असो. हें पांच प्रळय क्रमानें सांगितलें. ते कसें अनुभवाला येतात तें आतां सांगतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the dissolution of the five elements then, vivek will be clearly understood. Therefore now, that thoughtless Self should be brought to this `I am' experience (you who are that thoughtless Self should leave your buddhi/brahma and experience this `I am').

owis.original: निद्रा जेव्हां संचरे । तेव्हां जागृतीव्यापार सरे । सुषुप्ति अथवा स्वप्न भरे । अकस्मात आंगीं ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसाला झोप लागली कीं, त्याचे जागे असतांनाचे सर्व व्यवहार व व्याप थांबतात. मग त्याला झोप लागतें अगर झोपेंत स्वप्नें पडतात.
owis.englishMeaning: But when sleep is entered, then the pervasiveness of the waking state is moved aside and immediately, either deep sleep or a dream covers everything.

owis.original: या नांव निद्राप्रळये । जागृतीचा होये क्षये । आतां ऐका देहांतसमये । म्हणिजे मृत्युप्रळये ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या वर वर्णन केलेल्या अवस्थेला निद्राप्रळय म्हणतात. निद्राप्रळयामध्यें जागेपणाचा संपूर्ण क्षय झालेला असतो. आतां देहाचा मृत्यु म्हणजे मृत्यु प्रळय ऐका.
owis.englishMeaning: Then this *`I am' is the ignorance of sleep and there is the destruction of this waking state (knowledge must go off, otherwise one cannot sleep or die. But only in this waking state can you understand this `I am'). Now listen to that time when the body will end. This should be called dissolution by death. *(siddharameshwar maharaj- when you sleep, ignorance has become the object of knowledge)

owis.original: देहीं रोग बळावती । अथवा कठीण प्रसंग पडती । तेणें पंचप्राण जाती । व्यापार सांडुनी ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शरीराला रोग होतो. किंवा फार प्राणघातकप्रसंग येतो. त्यामुळें देहांत असणारे पंचप्राण देहाला सोडून निघून जातात.
owis.englishMeaning: When in the body a disease gains strength or great hardship befalls one then, the five pranas give up their duties and leave their places.

owis.original: तिकडे गेला मनपवनु । इकडे राहिली नुसती तनु । दुसरा प्रळये अनुमानु । असेचिना ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पंचप्राण निघून गेले कीं, मनांतील जाणीव पण जाते. मागें नुसता मृत देह उरतो. याला मृत्युप्रलय म्हणतात. हा प्रलय प्रत्यक्ष असतो त्याबद्दल अनुमान, कल्पना करण्याचे कारणच नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Then this wind or mind leaves and what remains is merely a corpse. One cannot specu- late as to where or when this dissolution by death will come.

owis.original: तिसरा ब्रह्मा निजेला । तों हा मृत्यु लोक गोळा जाला । अवघा व्यापार खुंटला । प्राणीमात्रांचा ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्मदेव झोपला म्हणजे तिसरा प्रळय सुरु होतो. त्यावेळीं मृत्यु लोकाचा गोळा होतो. पृथ्वीवरील सर्व प्राणीमात्रांचे व्यापार थांबतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The third dissolution is the sleep of lord brahma. Then this world of death and all these created things come to an end (ie. lord brahma is our buddhi which creates `many' names and forms. And this world of death is our waking state). Then everything in this world and all these activities in the prana are obstructed temporily (this sleep of brahma occurs when one seeks to understand the nature of this worldly existence. One learns from the Master that this world is created by our concepts. Upon dropping these concepts, the world created by lord brahma ie. our buddhi, goes off. In the beginning, this `silencing of the buddhi' is only tempory and then the concepts return bringing this world of the imagined jiva again)

owis.original: तेव्हां प्राणीयांचे सूक्ष्मांश । वायोचकीं करिती वास । कित्येक काळ जातां ब्रह्मयास । जागृती घडे ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तेव्हां सगळ्या प्राणीमात्रांचे सूक्ष्म देह ब्रह्मांडांतील वायुमध्यें जाऊन राहतात. अशा रीतीनें पुष्कळ काळ गेल्यावर ब्रह्मदेवाची रात्र संपून दिवस सुरु होतो. व तो जागा होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that subtle part of the prana stays in the realm of this wind `I am'. And when this time of the `I am' or `all' is destroyed then, lord brahma again awakes (ie. body consciousness returns and brahma/buddhi starts naming and creating `many' forms again and these forms appear before your eyes. But when he sleeps this world goes off and this wind of the `all' remains).

owis.original: पुन्हा मागुती सृष्टि रची । विसंचिले जीव मागुतें संची । सीमा होतां आयुष्याची । ब्रह्मप्रळय मांडे ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जागा झाल्यावर तो पुन्हा विश्वाची रचना करतो. इकडेतिकडे असलेल्या जीवांना तो एकत्र गोळा करतो. हा ब्रह्मांडाचा निद्राप्रळय मग ब्रह्मदेवाच्या आयुष्याचा शेवट येतो. त्यावेळीं ब्रह्मप्रळय सुरुं होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: And again this gross world is constructed and the harassed jiva is again brought back to meet the other harassed jivas. But when the end of lord brahma's lifetime comes then, there is the dissolution of brahma (with understanding and practice this `end of thoughts' is established and this is the fourth dissolution; the end of the brahmanda and the end of lord brahma. This is the `all' experience and the end of gross body consciousness).

owis.original: शत वरुषें मेघ जाती । तेणें प्राणी मृत्य पावती । असंभाव्य तर्के क्षिती । मर्यादेवेगळी ॥ १३ ॥
